title: Source Inventory, Scale Taxonomy & Authority Map
objective: Reconcile the governed source inventory, scale taxonomy and authority map for strategic command and large-scale conflict while preserving ordinary Combat/Action/Event truth, constituent identity, owner-domain authority and the no-duplicate-state/effects boundary.
governed_start_requirements: A future owner Continue is required before any application mutation.
Re-read the current SCL program/backlog plus only the minimum current Combat, MIB-14, MIB-13, MIB-09, WCI, completed ODL and World authority needed to resolve the exact SCL-01 source/scale map.
Resolve exact scale boundaries, source inventory, identity-preserving aggregation/projection rules and cross-scale handoffs at governed start rather than inferring them from the tranche title.
Ordinary Combat/Action/Event truth remains canonical; units/formations remain governed projections/aggregates and may not duplicate Character, inventory, vehicle, damage, casualty or event truth.
Constituent identity must persist across scale; aggregation/projection cannot silently fork authoritative state or double-apply effects.
Organization/faction/settlement/economy/world consequences remain committed only by their owning domains.
AI may advise future command decisions only where separately governed; SCL-01 selection grants no AI command, order or adjudication authority.
Persistence and migration remain closed at selection; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
Final validation must use exactly one SCL-01 current-family profile with zero historical predecessor fanout and exact-head self-hosted Linux/Windows plus deterministic comparison.
preserved_boundaries: ODL-01..09 remain completed_verified with implementation authority retired.
SCL-01 is selected only; no scale taxonomy, unit aggregate state, command hierarchy, order, phase, mechanical resolution, casualty/damage mapping or strategic consequence is implemented by selection.
Canonical owner domains, ordinary Combat/Action/Event truth, constituent identity and Permission/visibility authority remain unchanged.
No owner mutation, AI provider invocation, autonomous command/action/system permission, hidden-data reveal, duplicate ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
SCL-02+, MAL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

retry_basis.evidence: SCL-01 is selected as the strict successor only after ODL-09 completed_verified on exact application main f0fbab87d41e8962faf092da3599913d919ce6a5.
changed_since_previous: The ODL program is completed_verified through ODL-09 and its implementation authority is retired.
SCL-01 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or implementation authority.

next_action: On a future owner Continue, perform the bounded SCL-01 governed start from exact application main f0fbab87d41e8962faf092da3599913d919ce6a5 before any product mutation.
